interface.signature: def palindromepair(arr: list[str], N: int) -> bool

preconditions.expression: isinstance(arr, list) and all(isinstance(s, str) for s in arr)
preconditions.description: arr is a list of strings.
N is an integer equal to the length of arr.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in arr has length between 1 and 10 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == any((arr[i] + arr[j]) == (arr[i] + arr[j])[::-1] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if there exist two distinct indices i and j such that the concatenation of arr[i] and arr[j] is a palindrome; otherwise it returns False.
